notes_for_editor: The story no longer says the OSM node is at the site. The node (29.9494482, -84.5027470) is not compared with the station's coordinates in any source fetched, so the story states only the shared name. The 1928 sentence is paraphrased from the FDACS quote. No build, staffing or condition source found for this tower. The NHLR and FFLOS caches have no Saint James entry, and the Eastern US lookouts index (easternuslookouts.weebly.com/saint-james.html) lists only 'Saint James' and 'Franklin County' with no history. The 2019 Tate's Hell land management plan, searched for tower and James, has no mention of this tower; its only tower match is communication towers. OSM tags the node as an observation tower with lattice construction and ele=3; the 3 m is ground elevation, not tower height, so it was not recorded as height. Public access to the tower is not verified; the forest itself is a state forest. A search snippet mentioned a 2020 acquisition of the St. James Island Unit; it was not read and is not used. The statewide 1928 towers statement is context, not a claim about this tower. No photos. Wikidata also gives an image (St. James Forestry Site.jpg) that was not checked.
